semantic_admission: All members were admitted by exact manifest identity, safe relative regular-file headers, known own-project/evidence namespaces, and declared file type before semantic inspection. No linked dependency target was opened.

126 Python files and one .py.txt source-evidence file were decoded and AST parsed, with imports, calls, literals and security markers examined statically. Own wrappers may call native HDS/SDK if later executed; this inspection never imports or executes them. Historical sources are admitted as evidence, not as a safe-to-run or adopted runtime.
14 HDS v0.4.2 files in CP3 are unchanged repository-owned fixed core, individually equal in Git blob identity to the recovered baseline main tree. They are not official game/SDK source.

2164 JSON documents, including 1925 completely decoded XZ packets, are manifests, observations, own tool receipts, contracts, reports, typed HDS input/output/state, scoring or failure evidence. All JSON and typed-map duplicate keys were rejected; all four typed tag forms were validated without reconstructing native objects.

Public initial-observation base64 contains exactly 27 raw 4096-byte 64x64 palette arrays with verified declared SHA256. The two synthetic JSONL fixtures contain three rows each, each row with two 1x1 numeric frames; these are explicitly synthetic, not malformed official frames.

The full public teacher recording has 258 JSONL rows, 257 observed-action records with null reasoning, 5363 valid 64x64 palette frames and one public scorecard. The preserved failed download equals its first 50331648 bytes and ends mid-row220. Public recording WIN is historical teacher content, not evidence of new agent achievement.

Other 35 UTF-8 text members are own patches, Markdown reports/authority context, one source-evidence text, exit/log, report text, pyproject metadata or manifest digest. All were read and scanned; no unexpected binary body was found.

All detected long encoded strings resolve to public palette arrays; the authorization field is plain historical execution-policy prose. Ten code-like JSON strings are own recorded preparation/readback commands, a harness source readback or diagnostic output; 19 stored shell heredoc commands across those receipt files AST parse as own Python.

Known prepsave_guard_v1.cpython-312.pyc is preserved only under its exact supplied 5113-byte/SHA256 identity. Its contents were hashed only, never decoded, disassembled or executed. It remains a deliberate semantic-inspection exception.
limitations: No new native HDS, SDK, Query, Teach, Action, fresh run, fresh043 validation, replay, game solving, Git operation or upload occurred. This is preservation admission only.

No opaque official game/SDK source, dependency target or external referenced archive was read. Import/path references in own source are retained as historical evidence and do not establish a runnable self-contained environment.

Credential/PII review used complete text and structured-data scans, known marker/query/key patterns, code/import/literal inspection and public observation schema review. No candidate remained, but static scanning is not a proof that arbitrarily encoded secrets or all possible personal information are absent.

The single exact bytecode exception has no semantic-body inspection. Preservation admission depends on accepting this known hash-only historical artifact, not on a claim that its bytecode was inspected.

Goalset4 adds four correlated relation experiences (129 to133) and prepsave adds50 (133 to183). These counts are learning experiences, not cleared levels or independent environment trials. Stored scoring62/62 and112/112 is historical within-scope evidence, not a new evaluation.
